title: Native SwiftUI workspace manager
summary: Mac desktop surface for workspace status, task binding, editors and independent CPU/GPU renderer actions.

dates.note: Exact project start/end dates remain unknown. Direct local source/history review on 2026-10-29 supplements the supplied October 5 snapshot and separately dated owner statements. Commit milestones and review dates are not project starts or release dates.

facts.text: Developed a Swift/SwiftUI workspace manager exposing workspace status, task binding, editor launch, warnings and process controls.
Extended the native manager with independent CPU and GPU build, run, focus and termination actions, covering eight renderer-specific operations.

notes: Native SwiftUI launcher and later Tauri Workbench are related interfaces over shared workspace scripts; do not count their delegated backend operations as separate product features.
